title: Отговорка про маму и балет  (The Excuse About Mom and the Ballet)

segments.t: Embarrassed to admit that he is crashing at his sous-chef Lyova's apartment, Chef Barinov tells Elena Pavlovna that his own mother lives with him and hates late-night visitors. When he gets home, he finds Lyova and Vera Ivanovna glued to the ballet on television.
У меня кроме кофе ещё есть мама.

'Good evening, Viktor Petrovich.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'good' before landing on 'Petrovich'.
